SELECT CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) d, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) nd, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-26' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-28' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-29'

calls.statement:
SELECT 'fact total' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) nd, min(order_ts_utc) a, max(order_ts_utc) b FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc) FROM stg_web_order_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg in fact', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc) FROM stg_web_order_load WHERE web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg 28nov', count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), min(order_ts_utc), max(order_ts_utc) FROM stg_web_order_load WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)='2025-11-28'

WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)='2025-11-28')
SELECT count(*) orders,
 count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) d,
 sum(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN o.line_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_match
FROM o

SELECT CAST(sale_date AS DATE) sd, CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) ud, channel_code, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND (sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-27' AND '2025-11-29' OR CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-11-27' AND '2025-11-29')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
